name: Pandit Ramakant Sharma
reviews: Did the griha pravesh puja exactly as per North Indian vidhi, explained every step in Hindi.
Came on time and brought all samagri.

name: Pandit Venkatesh Bhat
reviews: Very knowledgeable, performs puja in Kannada and Sanskrit.
Good, but arrived 40 minutes late because of another booking.

name: Pandit Suresh Tiwari
reviews: Puja was fine but dakshina changed on the day, asked for more than agreed.
Speaks Hindi and Bhojpuri, good for North Indian families.

name: Sri Raghavendra Acharya
reviews: Punctual and very organised. Busy in wedding season, book early.
Performed vastu shanti and griha pravesh together.

name: Pandit Srinivasa Sastry
reviews: Telugu and Sanskrit, very patient with the family.
Did not show up once, sent a junior pandit without telling us.

name: Annapurna Caterers
reviews: Tasty North and South Indian veg food, staff was polite.
Food arrived 2 hours late for our pooja, guests waited.

name: Shree Krishna Bhojanalaya Caterers
reviews: Best Rajasthani and North Indian thali in Bengaluru, always on time.
Transport and serving staff charged extra, mention it upfront.

name: Udupi Ruchi Catering
reviews: Authentic Udupi food on banana leaf, very reliable.
Mostly South Indian, limited North Indian items.

name: Royal Feast Events and Catering
reviews: Cancelled the night before our function, had to order from a restaurant.
Good presentation, a bit expensive.

name: Andhra Spice Caterers
reviews: Spicy Andhra meals, can make North Indian on request.
Price per plate was raised after we confirmed the count.

name: Punjabi Rasoi Home Catering
reviews: Home-style Punjabi food, small orders welcome.
Owner answers calls himself, very responsive.

name: Mallige Flower Decorators
reviews: Beautiful marigold and mango leaf toran, fresh flowers.
Setup started late but finished before the muhurat.

name: Shubh Mangal Tent and Decor
reviews: Tent and chairs fine, flowers were extra and not told before.
Team did not come on the decided time.

name: Rangoli Events
reviews: Lovely rangoli and flower decor for house warming.
Clear pricing, no surprises.

name: Swagat Decor Studio
reviews: Modern decor, good for small functions.
Asked for full payment in advance.

name: Sweet Tooth Bakers
reviews: Eggless cakes taste great, delivered on time for our naamkaran.
Custom cradle design was lovely.

name: Bake Ghar
reviews: Good butterscotch cake, polite on the phone.
Delivered 2 hours late, the guests had already left.

name: Iyengar's Oven Fresh
reviews: Classic eggless cakes, fair price.
Busy on weekends, order three days ahead.

name: Lens and Light Studio
reviews: Captured every ritual of the griha pravesh, album in ten days.
Candid shots were beautiful.

name: Ravi Photography
reviews: Nice photos but did not show up for the second day.
Video editing took a month.

name: Moments by Meera
reviews: Speaks Hindi, great with kids at our mundan.
Delivered photos within a week.

name: Shree Lakshmi Tent House
reviews: Shamiana and chairs set up early, sound was clear.
Removed everything the same evening.

name: Royal Shamiana and Sound
reviews: Cheap, but the transport charge was raised after booking.
Mic stopped working during the puja.

name: Ganesh Tent and Lights
reviews: Good tent for 100 guests, helpful team.
Speaks Tamil and some Kannada.
